THE BLOCK: HeartSciences shareholders approved a merger with DCG-owned Zcash miner Fortitude, with roughly 86% of votes cast backing the deal. $ZEC 

Fortitude controls more than 60 MW of power capacity across seven U.S. sites.

The company expects to trade on Nasdaq as $TUDE after the deal closes.

raw.title: Initia Foundation 🪢 (@initiaFDN)
raw.body:
Initia Foundation has approved funding to cover verified bridge escrow shortfalls from the November 9th security incident. The approved limits are 3.67M INIT from its holdings and $330K in total for other assets. No INIT will be sold to fund this.

There is no claim process and users do not need to take any action. Please rely only on official Initia channels.
